headline:
Pioneers of Irrigation &
Landscape in Kutch
description: The Directors of Jal Agritech India Private Limited were previously operating an irrigation business under the name Omnath Irrigation & Neelkanth Nursery. To strengthen its market presence and establish it as a recognized brand, Jal Agritech India Private Limited was incorporated in 2020. Since then, the company has been providing comprehensive irrigation, automation, landscaping nursery & agricultural solutions under a structured corporate framework.
